headline: ICE presence in Seaside debunked.
summary: Recent posts purporting to show a federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement vehicle parked outside The Butter House restaurant in Seaside, and people handcuffed by ICE officers, have been circulating among locals on social media.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
